senses.meaning: Đồng phạm
examples: She became his unwitting accomplice in the robbery.
He was charged as an accomplice to the crime.
Police are searching for the accomplice who drove the getaway car.

senses.meaning: Cáo buộc, viện dẫn (chưa được chứng minh)
examples: Police allege the shooting was gang-related.
It is alleged that he stole over a million dollars.
The women allege that top executives routinely harassed female employees.

senses.meaning: Cáo buộc (chưa được chứng minh)
examples: Have you any evidence to support this allegation?
It took over two months to disprove the allegation.
She denied all the allegations made against her.

senses.meaning: Công tố viên, người đại diện buộc tội
examples: Once she became a prosecutor, she quickly established herself as a masterful trial lawyer.
The prosecutor recommended a fifteen-year sentence.
The state prosecutor described the police action as confused and disorganised.

senses.meaning: Tù nhân, người bị kết án
examples: The novel begins with Pip's meeting with an escaped convict.
The convict was released on parole after ten years.
A group of convicts escaped from the prison.

senses.meaning: Kết án, tuyên phạm tội
examples: There wasn't enough evidence to convict her.
He was convicted of murder and sentenced to life imprisonment.
The jury convicted him on three separate counts.

note: Trọng âm khác nhau: danh từ /ˈkɒnvɪkt/ (nhấn vần đầu), động từ /kənˈvɪkt/ (nhấn vần sau).

senses.meaning: Bất hợp pháp, vi phạm pháp luật
examples: Their action was judged illegal by the International Court.
It is illegal to sell alcohol to children.
Illegal hunting is threatening the survival of the species.

senses.meaning: Biện minh, bào chữa, chứng minh là đúng
examples: Ministers must appear before parliament and justify their actions.
Nothing can justify the use of violence against civilians.
He struggled to justify the expense to his superiors.

senses.meaning: Bồi thẩm đoàn
examples: The jury deliberated for three hours before reaching a decision.
The jury returned a unanimous verdict of not guilty.
Both sides were allowed to question potential jury members.

note: 'The jury is still out' là thành ngữ nghĩa là 'chưa có kết luận rõ ràng'.

senses.meaning: Kháng cáo; lời kêu gọi; sức hút
examples: The appeal was rejected by the High Court.
We launched an appeal for funds after the disaster.
The simplicity of the design is part of its appeal.

senses.meaning: Kháng cáo; kêu gọi; thu hút
examples: The defence appealed against the sentence.
He appealed to the public for calm.
The film appeals to a wide audience.

senses.meaning: Sự giam giữ (cảnh sát); quyền nuôi con
examples: He was kept in custody for his own safety.
After the riot, thirty-two people were taken into police custody.
The father was awarded custody of the children.

senses.meaning: Sự giam cầm, cầm tù
examples: They were held in confinement for three weeks.
He spent eleven years in solitary confinement.
Prisoners are punished by being placed in solitary confinement.

senses.meaning: Sự thông đồng, làm ngơ để cho phép điều xấu xảy ra
examples: The crime was committed with the connivance of a police officer.
He tried to bribe the police into connivance.
The fraud was only possible through the connivance of senior management.

senses.meaning: Sự thẩm vấn, hỏi cung
examples: Under interrogation, he refused to say anything for the first two hours.
She revealed the name of her accomplice during interrogation.
He confessed after four days of intensive interrogation.

senses.meaning: Làm chứng, khai trước toà
examples: She refused to testify against her brother.
Mr Molto has agreed to testify at the trial.
Can you testify that you saw the defendant at the scene of the crime?

senses.meaning: Kiện tụng, quá trình tố tụng dân sự
examples: Some business disputes require litigation to resolve.
It can help avoid expensive and protracted litigation.
The litigation will probably drag on for years.

senses.meaning: Trách nhiệm pháp lý; khoản nợ; người/thứ gây bất lợi
examples: Tenants have legal liability for any damage they cause.
The company maintains liability insurance for all its directors.
After the scandal, he became a liability to the party.

senses.meaning: Bị cáo, bị đơn
examples: The defendant pleaded not guilty.
The defendant was found guilty on all counts.
The judge instructed the defendant to rise.

senses.meaning: Giải oan, minh oan, chứng minh không có tội
examples: The pilot will surely be exculpated when all the facts are known.
He was exculpated by the testimony of several witnesses.
New DNA evidence may exculpate the accused.

senses.meaning: Hành vi sai trái, vi phạm quy tắc nghề nghiệp
examples: The doctor was accused of professional misconduct.
Investigators found evidence of gross misconduct.
The officer was dismissed for misconduct.

senses.meaning: Sự vĩnh viễn, mãi mãi (dùng nhiều trong văn bản pháp lý)
examples: They do not own the land in perpetuity.
The trust fund will ensure preservation of the site in perpetuity.
The agreement grants broadcasting rights in perpetuity.

note: Thường gặp trong cụm 'in perpetuity' = mãi mãi, vĩnh viễn.

senses.meaning: Lời khai, lời chứng; bằng chứng
examples: The testimony of witnesses vindicated the defendant.
Barker's testimony is crucial to the prosecution's case.
His success is a testimony to years of hard work.

senses.meaning: Cuộc điều tra pháp y (đặc biệt về nguyên nhân tử vong)
examples: The inquest heard that she died from multiple injuries.
The coroner will hold an inquest into the deaths.
An inquest found that the deceased had died of a drugs overdose.

senses.meaning: Phán quyết, kết luận
examples: The jury were unanimous in their verdict.
The jury returned a verdict of not guilty.
The response to the verdict was one of outrage.

senses.meaning: Truy tố, đưa ra xét xử
examples: Does the agency have the power to prosecute companies?
The district attorney decided not to prosecute.
Trespassers will be prosecuted.

senses.meaning: Xâm phạm trái phép (tài sản, quyền riêng tư, lòng hiếu khách)
examples: I always prosecute people who trespass on my land.
I don't want to trespass on your hospitality any further.
Signs warned visitors not to trespass beyond the barrier.

senses.meaning: Hành vi xâm phạm trái phép
examples: He was fined for trespass on private land.
The court found him guilty of trespass.
A notice was posted warning against trespass on the property.

senses.meaning: Pháp luật, luật được ban hành
examples: The government rushed through legislation aimed at organised crime.
New legislation was introduced to protect consumer rights.
This legislation effectively prevents us from trading abroad.

senses.meaning: Ly hôn, sự ly hôn
examples: They decided to get a divorce after twenty years together.
The divorce was finalised last month.
She filed for divorce after discovering the affair.

senses.meaning: Ly hôn; tách rời khỏi
examples: She divorced him after discovering the affair.
He divorced his wife and remarried a year later.
You cannot divorce politics from economics in this analysis.

senses.meaning: Tố giác, lên án công khai
examples: We must denounce injustice wherever it occurs.
Ministers took the floor to denounce the decision.
Human rights groups denounced the arrests as politically motivated.

senses.meaning: Vu khống bằng lời nói (phỉ báng nói — phân biệt với libel là phỉ báng viết)
examples: A reputation that was besmirched by slander.
He is being sued for slander.
Many teachers saw the statement as a gross slander on their profession.

senses.meaning: Vu khống, nói xấu, phỉ báng bằng lời nói
examples: He was accused of slandering his former colleague.
She had to issue an apology after slandering the minister on live TV.
It is an offence to slander a public official.

note: Slander = phỉ báng bằng lời nói; libel = phỉ báng bằng văn bản. Cả hai đều là tội 'defamation'.

senses.meaning: Xâm phạm, vi phạm (quyền, luật pháp, bản quyền)
examples: This law is starting to infringe on our personal liberties.
He occasionally infringes the law by parking illegally.
Two of the projects are deemed to infringe EU legislation.

senses.meaning: Bất hợp pháp, phi pháp; trái đạo đức xã hội
examples: They were prosecuted for illicit liquor selling.
The college cannot condone any behaviour involving illicit drugs.
The police cracked down on illicit trading.

note: Phân biệt với 'elicit' (gợi ra, khai thác) — phát âm giống nhau nhưng nghĩa hoàn toàn khác.

senses.meaning: Hệ thống hoá, pháp điển hoá (viết thành luật hoặc quy tắc chính thức)
examples: The agreement must still be codified by federal legislation.
It brought forth written constitutions and codified basic rights.
The laws were codified into a single document.

senses.meaning: Cuộc điều tra, sự thẩm tra
examples: The enquiry must be independently conducted.
They've passed the enquiry over to the police.
The police are following several lines of enquiry.

note: Tiếng Anh Anh: 'enquiry' thường dùng cho hỏi thăm thông thường; 'inquiry' cho điều tra chính thức. Tiếng Anh Mỹ dùng 'inquiry' cho cả hai.

senses.meaning: Thủ phạm, người thực hiện hành vi phạm tội
examples: The perpetrator of this crime must be traced.
DNA evidence helped identify the perpetrator.
The perpetrator fled the scene before police arrived.

senses.meaning: Được miễn, không phải tuân theo (quy định, thuế, nghĩa vụ)
examples: Charitable organisations are exempt from certain taxes.
No one is exempt from the law.
Children under five are exempt from the entrance charge.

senses.meaning: Miễn cho, cho phép không phải tuân theo
examples: The law exempts students from paying council tax.
She was exempted from jury duty due to illness.
Small businesses were exempted from the new regulations.

senses.meaning: Giảm nhẹ (mức độ nghiêm trọng của tội lỗi, lỗi lầm)
examples: There were extenuating circumstances that the judge took into account.
He offered no extenuating argument in his defence.
His difficult upbringing was cited as an extenuating factor.

note: Thường gặp ở dạng tính từ 'extenuating' trong cụm 'extenuating circumstances' (hoàn cảnh giảm nhẹ tội).

senses.meaning: Tịch thu, sung công (nhà nước thu hồi tài sản tư nhân)
examples: The government expropriated the land from private owners.
His property was expropriated without fair compensation.
The law allows the state to expropriate assets in cases of national interest.

senses.meaning: Sự chứng thực, xác nhận chính thức
examples: The document required official attestation before submission.
She provided an attestation of her qualifications.
Attestation of identity is required to open a bank account.

senses.meaning: Tính hợp pháp, tính chính danh
examples: The legitimacy of the election was questioned by opposition parties.
They challenged the legitimacy of the new government.
His claim to the throne lacked legal legitimacy.

senses.meaning: Giấy phép, bằng lái (tài liệu cho phép làm gì đó)
examples: You need a licence to operate that type of vehicle.
He was stripped of his driving licence after the offence.
The restaurant was granted a licence to serve alcohol.

senses.meaning: Cấp phép, cho phép chính thức
examples: The company was licensed to operate in three countries.
He was licensed to carry a firearm.
The government licenses pharmaceutical companies to produce vaccines.

note: Tiếng Anh Anh: danh từ là 'licence', động từ là 'license'. Tiếng Anh Mỹ dùng 'license' cho cả hai.

senses.meaning: Tội phạm; sự xúc phạm
examples: He was charged with a serious offence.
No offence was intended by the remark.
A first offence usually results in a lighter sentence.

note: Tiếng Anh Anh: 'offence'; Tiếng Anh Mỹ: 'offense'.

senses.meaning: Sự tuân thủ (quy định, luật pháp)
examples: All staff must act in compliance with company policy.
Compliance with environmental regulations is mandatory.
The audit found full compliance across all departments.

senses.meaning: Tội hối lộ
examples: He was charged with bribery and corruption.
Bribery of public officials carries a heavy sentence.
The investigation revealed widespread bribery in the construction sector.

senses.meaning: Sự bắt giữ, sự bắt giam
examples: Police made several arrests following the riot.
He was placed under house arrest pending trial.
The suspect was held under arrest for forty-eight hours.

senses.meaning: Bắt giữ; ngăn chặn (nghĩa bóng)
examples: The suspect was arrested at the airport.
Two people were arrested and taken in for questioning.
A new drug has been found to arrest the spread of the cancer.

senses.meaning: Bắt giữ (tội phạm); hiểu, nắm bắt (nghĩa bóng)
examples: The fugitive was apprehended at the border.
Officers worked throughout the night to apprehend the suspect.
She could not quite apprehend the full meaning of the phrase.

senses.meaning: Hành hung, tấn công thể chất; cuộc tấn công quân sự
examples: He was charged with assault after the altercation.
The troops launched a full assault on the position at dawn.
She was the victim of a violent assault.

senses.meaning: Hành hung, tấn công
examples: He was charged after assaulting a police officer.
The troops assaulted the enemy stronghold at dawn.
She was assaulted in the car park late at night.

senses.meaning: Tha tội, giải oan; miễn trừ trách nhiệm
examples: The court absolved him of all charges.
She refused to absolve him of responsibility for the accident.
In the confessional, the priest absolves the penitent.

senses.meaning: Sự huỷ bỏ (hôn nhân, hợp đồng) — coi như chưa bao giờ tồn tại
examples: She applied for an annulment of the marriage.
The annulment meant the contract had never been legally valid.
An annulment differs from a divorce in that it treats the marriage as void.

note: Phân biệt: annulment (hôn nhân bị tuyên vô hiệu từ đầu), divorce (chấm dứt hôn nhân hợp lệ).

senses.meaning: Ngành tư pháp, hệ thống toà án
examples: An independent judiciary is essential to democracy.
The judiciary ruled the law unconstitutional.
Public confidence in the judiciary has declined in recent years.

senses.meaning: Sự kết án; niềm tin mạnh mẽ
examples: She appealed unsuccessfully against her conviction for murder.
The High Court later quashed his conviction.
He argued his case with great conviction.

senses.meaning: Quan toà, thẩm phán (thường xét xử các vụ án nhỏ)
examples: The magistrate issued a warrant for his arrest.
The magistrate remanded him in custody for two weeks.
The defendant was summoned before a magistrate.

senses.meaning: Thông đồng, làm ngơ trước điều sai trái
examples: Some government officials connive at corruption.
Not to protest is to connive at the destruction of the environment.
The guards connived with the escapees.

senses.meaning: Thủ phạm; nguyên nhân (nghĩa mở rộng)
examples: Are you the culprit who broke this window?
The police put the culprit in jail.
High production costs are the main culprit behind the price rise.

senses.meaning: Thuộc tư pháp, liên quan đến toà án và xét xử
examples: The inquiry acknowledges failings in the judicial system.
Greenpeace applied for a judicial review to challenge the decision.
The president's powers are subject to judicial oversight.

senses.meaning: Tội phóng hỏa, đốt phá có chủ ý và bất hợp pháp
examples: He was convicted of arson and sentenced to five years in prison.
The fire was quickly identified as arson.
Police are investigating the blaze as a possible arson attack.

senses.meaning: Sự trục xuất ra khỏi đất nước
examples: He was facing deportation after his visa expired.
The government ordered the deportation of undocumented migrants.
She fled the deportation order and went into hiding.

senses.meaning: Phán xét, xét xử, phân xử (tranh chấp)
examples: The panel was asked to adjudicate a dispute between two contractors.
The court will adjudicate on the constitutional question next month.
An independent body was appointed to adjudicate complaints.

senses.meaning: Theo luật định, được quy định bởi pháp luật
examples: Workers have a statutory right to take parental leave.
The statutory deadline for tax returns is 31 January.
The regulator failed to carry out its statutory duties.

senses.meaning: Sự tình cờ, ngẫu nhiên
examples: The evidence was discovered by happenstance during an unrelated search.
The court ruled it was not happenstance but a deliberate act.
Liability cannot rest on happenstance alone.

senses.meaning: Nguyên đơn (bên đứng kiện trong vụ án dân sự)
examples: The plaintiff must prove their claim on the balance of probabilities.
The judge found in favour of the plaintiff.
The plaintiff sought two million dollars in damages.

note: Phân biệt: plaintiff (nguyên đơn), defendant (bị đơn/bị cáo).

senses.meaning: Quyền tị nạn chính trị; nơi trú ẩn an toàn
examples: The refugee applied for asylum at the border crossing.
Granting asylum is a legal obligation under international law.
His asylum claim was rejected on procedural grounds.

senses.meaning: Hối lộ, tiền/quà mua chuộc
examples: The politician denied ever accepting a bribe.
He was arrested for offering a bribe to a public official.
Several officials were implicated in a bribery scandal.

senses.meaning: Đưa hối lộ, mua chuộc
examples: He tried to bribe the official with a large sum of money.
She was found guilty of bribing a public servant.
He bribed his way through the customs checkpoint.

senses.meaning: Tham nhũng, hối lộ (nghĩa chính trị/pháp lý)
examples: The report exposed years of graft within the police force.
Officials accused of graft were removed from their posts.
Graft has undermined public trust in government institutions.
